ok I need to vent for a sec.

some sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co is selling my switchblade moth. MY moth, the one I drew for the sept 13 flash day. I posted the whole sheet on aug 30, 12 designs, first come first serve, and the moth was gone in the first hour of the day. one design, one person, one payment. thats the whole deal, and the person who got it paid for it.

they're calling it the "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal," $6.50 or 3 for $15. and heres the thing, its not "inspired by" anything, moths are not a motif I invented. this drawing is mine. same little crack in the blade, same wing pattern, they didnt even flip it, its a straight scan of my linework. I posted that sheet so people could see it and then book it with me, not so a print shop could cut it up and sell it by the inch.

I messaged them and the whole reply was "love your work!" then "moths are a very common tattoo motif" and then a link to send registered copyright through their support form. cool. I have the original drawing and the dated post. I do not have a registered copyright, because that costs money I dont have to spare, and neither does half the flash artists on any platform youve ever scrolled. these sticker places know that. its a volume game on their end and a math problem for us.

if you got this moth from me: that sticker did not come from me. I dont sell stickers, I dont do prints, I dont license anything, and the only copy of this design in the world is the one on your skin. you paid for it, its yours, and its supposed to be one of one. I got a message tonight from someone who thought I was the one selling stickers of their own tattoo and it nearly broke my brain.

if you bought a knife moth from StickerBurrow Co, please report the listing, and please dont buy from them in the meantime. if you already bought one, report it anyway and then toss it, you did nothing wrong, you just liked my drawing.

and if you run a sticker shop or a print shop anywhere: dont scan our flash sheets. we dont have legal departments, we are just trying to make a living and most of us cant afford to fight you over a decal. take the work you drew yourself.

ok. rant over.

hey im not mad at you at all, you did the right thing sending it to me. and no lol, I am not selling stickers of anything. that moth went to one person on sept 13 and that is the only place it is supposed to exist.

I put a post up on my own page tonight (not the shop page, its my personal thing) asking people to report the StickerBurrow Co listing and not buy from them. if you want to report it too that helps, the more reports that come from the actual artist the faster they have to look at it.

one more thing, can you pass this along to whoever got the moth from me? they messaged me tonight thinking I was the one selling stickers of their tattoo and I really want them to know it wasnt me. the design was sold once, to one person, who paid for it, and I dont make stickers or prints at all. if its the same person who bought a decal from your niece, that one isnt from me either.

and tell your niece thanks for the heads up, and if she still has the receipt she should report the listing too. she didnt do anything wrong, she just liked my drawing.
